title: Sectionwise image and injectivity of open extension by zero
statement: Let f:X->Y be an open immersion of schemes, Lambda a commutative ring, and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on X_et [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. On every etale V over Y, the canonical comparison f_!F->f_*F from extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is injective and has exactly the sections of F(X_V) whose support is proper over V as image [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support, lem-cbc-proper-support-section-calculus].

proof.text: Restriction of the support inclusion to X is an isomorphism: for an etale object over X, its base change back along the open immersion has an isomorphic projection to that object, hence every closed support is proper.

Invert that restriction followed by the restriction/pushforward counit. The extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction gives q:f_!F->f_!supp F. Counit naturality identifies q followed by the literal support inclusion with the canonical comparison.

At a point outside X, represent any germ of the support sheaf by a support section. Its support has closed image I in the etale neighbourhood, by proper closed-image preservation. I misses the marked point. On the open complement of I every restricted geometric germ vanishes, using the restriction germ formula; the shared module_section_zero_of_germs theorem from the support-image module shows the section itself vanishes. Thus the support-sheaf stalk is zero.

On X the restriction of q is an isomorphism by the adjunction unit/counit identities. Outside X its source and target stalks are zero, using the extension-by-zero stalk theorem and the preceding step. Stalk detection makes q an isomorphism. Composing q with the literal support inclusion gives injectivity and the asserted component image.

theorem openExtensionProperSupport_range (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale) :
    Function.Injective
      (((openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).app F).hom.app (op V)) ∧
    ∀ s, (∃ t,
      (((openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).app F).hom.app
        (op V)) t = s) ↔
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s
